actionError.invalid_params: The device did not understand the details of the action.
actionError.player_not_running: The player is not running on this device.
actionError.reboot_not_permitted: The device does not allow the reboot (the permission from the installer is missing).
actionError.send_failed: The action could not be sent to the device.
actionError.unknown_action: The device software does not know this action. Bring the device to the server version.
actionState.timeout: The device did not answer in time.
alert.gpu_lost: Graphics acceleration lost – the player runs in software
alert.video_fallback: Hardware video decoding switched off after errors
alerts.ackTitle: Acknowledge the problem: it no longer counts as open until it is gone and comes back.
alerts.ackedHint: They do not count as open. A problem that is gone and comes back is shown again.
alerts.empty: No problems. All paired devices are working.
alerts.subtitle: Problems of paired devices. Open a device to fix it.
align.hint: Installs the server version {version} on this device. The screen restarts briefly.
align.started: The device is being brought to the server version.
applied.failed: The device could not apply the change: {reason}
applied.local: The device uses a mode set in its own web interface: {mode}
applied.offline: Applied as soon as the device is online again.
applied.pending: Waiting for the device to apply the change …
applied.timeout: The device has not confirmed the change.
claimHint: Enter the PIN shown on this screen. Only then is the device paired with this server.
clean.hint: Only files that neither the current nor the previous content nor a download in progress needs are deleted.
clean.nothing: Nothing to clean: every file in the cache is still needed.
clock.peer: from a device in the LAN (server unreachable)
clock.title: Clock
deleteConfirm: Delete this device? It returns to the PIN screen and must be taken over again.
dismissed: “{name}” is hidden until the screen asks again (after a restart or 24 h). It can still be taken over with its PIN.
displayHint: Applied immediately and kept after restarts. Empty = what the screen reports as preferred.
empty: No devices yet. Install the player software on a screen; it appears here with its PIN.
fingerprintHint: For safety, compare the server key on the screen: {fingerprint}
forceMode: Force the mode even if the screen does not report it
ipOverlay: Show IP address for 12 seconds at start
mode.autoPreferred: Automatic – preferred mode of the screen ({mode})
mode.customHint: Forces a mode the screen does not report. If the screen cannot show it, the device keeps its previous mode.
mode.hint: Applied when saved and kept after restarts.
mode.invalid: Width 320–7680, height 200–4320 and refresh rate 0–240 Hz (0 = 60 Hz).
mode.none: The device does not report its display modes (no display control or older software). Automatic or a custom mode can still be set.
mon.gpuLost: Software – graphics acceleration lost, restarting the player did not help (tried again every hour)
mon.gpuRecovered: Graphics acceleration restored after a loss: {count}× (last {time})
mon.powerLowNow: Under-voltage now (events since start: {count}) – the device slows down
mon.title: Monitoring
mon.unsupportedPi3: Known issue: the hardware video decoder fails about every 15–20 minutes when videos change often. It can work with simple content; a Raspberry Pi 4 or a small x86 PC is recommended.
mon.videoFallback: Software – hardware decoding failed repeatedly (until the next restart)
offlineActions: The device is offline; remote actions are available when it reconnects.
pending: New screens waiting to be taken over
placeHint: Place n shows track n of a playlist for several screens. Empty: next free place.
rebootConfirm: Reboot the device now? The screen is dark for about a minute.
regen.confirm: The screen shows only white noise instead of the content until you stop it or the player restarts. This evens out burn-in on plasma screens, e.g. outside opening hours.
regen.running: Plasma regeneration is running: the screen shows white noise until you stop it or the player restarts.
repairConfirm: The device returns to the PIN screen and must be taken over again. Its content data is deleted; display settings are kept.
storage.criticalText: Less than 10 % of the disk is free on this device. New content may not be loaded. Clean the cache now.
storage.unknown: The device does not report its storage (older software or not connected yet).
storage.warningText: Less than 20 % of the disk is free on this device. Consider cleaning the cache.
versionMismatchClaim: This device runs version {version}, which differs from the server. It is brought to the server version after taking over.
